# Template Lab vendored browser dependencies

These files are checked into the application so Template Lab works on a LAN without access to a public CDN.

| File | Source | License | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axios-1.20.0.min.js` | `https://unpkg.com/axios@1.20.0/dist/axios.min.js` | MIT | `7C433C881C3B0903317193A0DD5AF714CE0F65CF77D5C7F067F18B96F0E8E2C7` |
| `fabric-5.3.0.min.js` | `https://unpkg.com/fabric@5.3.0/dist/fabric.min.js` | MIT | `48F8F0915BEB512FC7FE1B48C0EEB075DD0803C790EFDFD75CD007F9C3EEA2CA` |

When upgrading, update both the filename references in the Template Lab HTML files and the hashes above.
